_meta.name: Warli pronunciation lexicon (OPTIONAL module - seed)
_meta.description: word -> phonetic respelling used to NUDGE a Hindi/Marathi TTS voice toward more authentic Warli pronunciation before synthesis. Derived from the lipi/pronunciation research papers + transcribed YouTube/field audio. This module is fully DECOUPLED: if this file is empty or missing, TTS reads the Devanagari text unchanged. Accuracy scales with how much transcribed Warli audio the team collects.
_meta.status: SEED / OPTIONAL. Extend `lexicon` as more audio is transcribed.

entry_fields.respell: Devanagari respelling fed to the TTS voice to approximate true Warli sounds.
entry_fields.ipa: Optional IPA-like notation for documentation/future fine-tuning.
entry_fields.source: Where the pronunciation was heard, e.g. 'youtube:<id>@00:23' or 'field:palghar'. Credit sources in sources.md.
